_comment: Independent C-first cockatrice-egg route. A sibling inventory probe with the same character, date, time, and seed identified the wished egg at slot o. The first missing behavior is eat.c:fprefx’s EGG branch for a non-Pyrolisk, non-stale egg, which calls give_feedback. After that command continues, eat.c:fpostfx applies delayed stoning. Cockatrice corpse meat instead follows eat.c:cprefx and ends the game immediately, so this recipe eats the source-identified egg.
